lines.trans: Do you want to hang yourself?

words.gloss: to me (мне некогда = I have no time)

words.gram: 3rd person masculine singular, accusative; г is said like в

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.
I'm calling to say thank you.
So that there are witnesses, Samson.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to love, to like', paired with 'полюбить'.

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.en: to stop, put an end to

examples.trans: Stop it! We will have the flat.

examples.text: Да ну что вы, прекратите! Это жизнь.
examples.trans: Oh, come on, stop it! That's life.

meanings.note: Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'hang oneself'.

examples.text: Хочешь вешаться — вешайся, мне всё равно.
examples.trans: You want to hang yourself — hang yourself, I do not care.
Do you want to hang yourself?

meanings.note: almost always in 'всё равно' = it doesn't matter; мне всё равно = I don't care

examples.text: Мне всё равно. Что ты, что он.
examples.trans: It's all the same to me. You or him.

постоять.gloss: to stand for a while; to wait

examples.trans: I'll stand here for a bit.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to joke', paired with 'пошутить'.

examples.text: Шутишь? Правда, скажи, где деньги? Меня наняли.
examples.trans: Are you joking? Seriously, tell me, where's the money? They hired me.

examples.text: Экскаваторщик — это не мой уровень. Может, поможешь?
examples.trans: Excavator driver isn't my level. Maybe you could help?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'делать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'make, cause'.

examples.text: Что, я зря пришла? Я надела костюм зайки!
examples.trans: What, did I come for nothing? I put on a bunny costume!

meanings.note: 'mum will kill me' = I'll be in big trouble

examples.trans: Do you want to kill me?

examples.text: Ты смотришь на меня так, как будто убить хочешь.
examples.trans: You look at me as if you want to kill me.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: Do you think that's really possible?
It's realistic to do that in a day.

examples.text: Я не шучу и реально сваливаю отсюда.
examples.trans: I am not joking and am seriously getting out of here.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'веситься'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'hang oneself'.
